title: Power Up Ōtaki: reported project purpose
claim: The project organisation describes solar supplying the wastewater treatment plant and college, excess electricity exported to the grid, and proceeds directed to a community fund.

context.period: Historical project description; current fund operations require separate evidence
context.method: Paraphrase of the organisation's public webpage; no independent operational verification

limitations: This is not evidence of free electricity for all households.
The description does not supply a demand profile, full current financial accounts or complete project lifecycle impacts.
Current fund status must be read separately from historical project purpose.

rights.note: Link and short attributed paraphrase only; no source data or publication relicensed.

title: Reported solar array capacities
claim: The project owner reports 107 kWp at the wastewater site and 23 kWp at the college; these are peak capacities, not annual energy totals.

context.method: Source-checked public report or webpage; factual extraction, not independent reconciliation to meters or accounts.

limitations: A participant account describes 106.8 kWp for the wastewater array; source precision differs.
Capacity alone cannot establish annual generation or household benefits.

rights.note: Short attributed factual extract and source link. No report layout, raw dataset or third-party model copied; open-data redistribution licence not established.
